answer: A digital archive pays agents to index a sonnet about a river fed by a glacier. To resist Sybil bids, it issues one allocation credit per token irreversibly burned, with no signup credits. Validators verify each burn on the ledger and consume its unique output once. Job selection is linear in credits committed, so moving 100 credits across 100 aliases leaves total selection weight at 100. Buying ten times that weight destroys ten times the tokens; self-trading cannot recover the burn.
